question: What exalted beings or states may one become through this yogic attainment?
premises: One may become a divine maiden of the gods
One may become a yakṣa or vidyādhara
inference: The practice can lead to becoming a divine maiden or a yakṣa-vidyādhara
uncertainties: The compound yakṣa+vidyādharo may imply a pair or a single class
plain_english: One may become a divine maiden of the gods, or a yakṣa or a vidyādhara.
